output: Hypothesis: The principal component value of PC1 in the beginning of the Younger Bronze Age (1100 BCE) may differ from the subsequent time horizons (1000 to 500 BCE) due to changes in environmental or cultural factors affecting pollen data. However, due to the lack of sufficient data in the "pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv" dataset for the specified time range, it is not possible to draw a statistically significant conclusion about this relationship. Further data collection or interpolation techniques may be necessary to fill in the missing values and enable a more comprehensive analysis.
